title: Peru's PCM approves National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030
date_note: Correo Peru says the resolution was published in El Peruano on 24 November, the same day as the article; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: agency (PCM) in the capital; the page names no city
summary: Correo Peru reports that Peru's Presidency of the Council of Ministers (PCM) approved the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2026-2030, published in the official gazette El Peruano and taking effect on 25 November. The article says public administration entities, regional and local government companies and FONAFE companies must implement it, and that non-compliance may bring administrative, civil or criminal liability.
plain: Peru's government has approved a national cybersecurity plan for 2026-2030. Public bodies must apply it, and the article says failing to do so may bring legal liability.
exec: Peruvian public bodies and FONAFE companies must implement the new strategy, per Correo Peru; private firms may use it as a reference.
impact: Policy approval; the page gives no budget or statistics.

validation.note: One publisher (Correo Peru) read; the El Peruano resolution text was not found or read.
